name: Island Park KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 5152 N. HWY 20, Island Park; full-hookup RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $107-129 a night before tax for a mid-May 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4*, $$$. --Claude
